title: audit detail auth.recovery
description: detail of audit rows with action auth.recovery: recovery ceremony step (rotate: the recovery code was replaced, KOR-01; rotate_begin: the user asked for the challenge of a replacement, KOR-40). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
